name: GTM Chief Of Staff
tagline: Carries the admin around enterprise deals so you can sell
description: Built for sellers working large accounts, it takes on the work that surrounds a conversation: briefing you ahead of a call, keeping the inbox in order, and writing up whatever should go out afterwards. Jobs outside that remit, a pitch deck say, get passed to a bot that specialises in them.
author: thekuchh
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
